object_description: S-shaped elongated building complex enclosing a grass-field courtyard
design_condition: The S-shaped complex works with the eastern manufacturing building to enclose a grass-field outdoor space, while a small forecourt addresses Grüntalstrasse and the sports hall connects directly to neighboring parking.

positive.statement: The project offers an innovative solution by combining kindergarten, school and sports hall under one roof.

position.target: kindergarten, school and sports hall under one roof
position.rationale: S-shaped integrated mass visibly combines several elongated wings around the courtyard.

positive.statement: The enclosed outdoor space creates an attractive spatial atmosphere for the complex.

position.rationale: Central open court is clearly enclosed by the surrounding S-shaped building edges.

positive.statement: The escape balconies allow the central corridor to be used as a teaching zone and shade the glazed facades in summer.

position.rationale: Balcony-like linear edges follow the inner corridor-facing sides of the central wings.

positive.statement: The sports hall is easy to reach from the neighboring parking spaces and can also be entered directly from the school.

position.target: sports hall access from neighboring parking
position.rationale: A southern forecourt and adjacent eastern wing provide the likely parking-side sports access.

positive.statement: The planned green facade can be expected to create an attractive spatial atmosphere in the classrooms.

position.rationale: The long eastern-facing glazed edge is the most plausible classroom facade location.

negative.statement: Access to the kindergarten and school is difficult to find.

position.rationale: Public approach is constrained to the small southern forecourt and building entry zone.

negative.statement: The kindergarten does not have its own outdoor space.

position.rationale: No separate kindergarten yard is distinguishable within the enclosed exterior arrangement.

negative.statement: The high glass content has a negative impact on costs and operating energy.

position.rationale: The likely glazed classroom edge is assigned to the long eastern facade.

negative.statement: The cloakrooms are only accessible through the public area and stands.

position.target: cloakrooms through public area and stands
position.rationale: The circulation concern is placed near the southern public approach and internal entry zone.
